statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
CPT code 93229 (continuous mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The diagnosis codes I48.91 and I49.5 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic palpitations and lightheadedness with arrhythmic activity
